scientific_integrity: Exact rational polynomial determinant identities checked by the included standalone SymPy script; all-node quantified claims deduced from coefficient signs and a Loewner-kernel congruence, not finite numerical sampling.
scientific_limitations: The Hadamard-square condition is only a necessary differential condition for Frobenius radial convexity; no claim of full radial convexity or its conjectured equivalence is made.
No conclusion is claimed for Loewner matrices of size four or greater.
A possibly equivalent older result in positive-kernel literature cannot be categorically excluded; the older Hiai–Sano full text was inaccessible.
title: Global third-order Loewner-square positivity without three-matrix monotonicity
